method: Aggregates only cited observations after an independent verification pass. Group membership is a lexical signal for prioritization, not a semantic adoption decision.

policy.adopt: No capability is auto-adopted. A signal enters a separate SPEC→PLAN→RED→BUILD→VERIFY decision cycle.
policy.defer: External side effects, vendor integrations, and ambiguous claims remain deferred until a human selects them.
policy.static: Binary/opaque files are closed as STATIC_REVIEWED with byte metadata only; no textual semantics are claimed.
